name: Money Mornings
audience: creative freelancers who open their banking app with one eye shut
promise: Ten calm minutes a week and you will always know where your money is.
cta: Grab the Monday money page. Comment MORNING and I will send it.
stories: I used to hide invoices in a shoebox. A real shoebox.
A client paid me six months late and I did not notice for four of them.
Now I do my numbers with coffee every Monday and it is my favourite part of the week.
